What We Do

Four Pillars.
One Team.

01 ☀️
Commercial Solar & Backup

Full-scale solar design and installation for commercial, residential and off-grid applications. From 5kW residential systems to 470-panel retirement village installations. Load-shedding solutions that keep your business running. All installations carried out by a SAPVIA-approved PV GreenCard Installer.

02 📡
Telecom Infrastructure

DAS site builds, rooftop installations, monopole towers, gantry systems and 5G infrastructure. Trusted subcontractor to Vodacom, MTN, Cell C and Nokia across the Western Cape and beyond.

03 🏗️
Civil & Structural Works

Underground cable routes, bunker installations, CCTV infrastructure, hard-facing security solutions and motorised gate installations. End-to-end civil capability with our own qualified crew.

04 ⚙️
Engineering & Fabrication

Specialist steel fabrication and custom engineering solutions. From racing car builds to bespoke outdoor structures. Precision craftsmanship you can see and trust.

05 🔋
Battery & Epoxy Systems

Large-scale battery epoxy projects for MTN and Telkom Mobile across 79 sites. Proven track record in critical infrastructure maintenance and upgrade programmes with South Africa's biggest networks.

06 🌿
Off-Grid & Remote Solutions

Solar and repeater installations in remote, off-grid environments including nature reserves and mountain peaks. Where conventional contractors won't go, Nito finds a way.

Flagship Project
★ Case Study · Solar

Silvermine Village
Retirement Estate

Nito Industries designed and delivered a full-scale solar and battery backup system for Silvermine Village, a 217-home retirement estate in Cape Town. The system was engineered to slash power consumption by 50%, eliminate load-shedding disruption and sustain critical facilities including a kitchen producing 500 meals per day and an 80-bed healthcare facility. Total project value: approximately R17 million.

The Nito Story

More Than a Business.
A Legacy.

The story of Marius and Thomas van der Merwe. A father, a son and a company built from the ground up with grit, expertise and genuine pride in the work.

Our Journey

From a Single Tool Kit to Cape Town's Most Trusted Engineering Team.

1994

Project Election

Marius van der Merwe works on Project Election, rolling out telephone lines to voting stations across the Free State ahead of South Africa's first democratic election.

The Birth of GSM in South Africa

The same year, GSM arrives in South Africa and the mobile network era begins. Demand for tower, cable and RF work rises sharply.

1994
1995

First Towers for Vodacom

Marius joins the first branch building RF sites for Vodacom, erecting the towers that carry the country's earliest mobile signal. He spends the next two decades in telecom infrastructure.

Thomas Matriculates and Joins

Thomas matriculates and joins his father in the business, learning the trade on site alongside him.

2015
2018

Nito Industries and Lantis Motorsport Launch

Nito Industries is officially registered, and Lantis Motorsport launches alongside it. Within the first year the company completes multiple rooftop builds for Cell C, MTN infrastructure upgrades and its first multi-site contracts. The fabrication side begins building Formula Vee racing cars.

Expanding Into Solar

Marius and Thomas expand Nito's capabilities into commercial solar and battery backup, applying the same engineering discipline used on telecom sites to system design, component selection and installation.

2021
2023

Thomas Earns the PV GreenCard

Thomas qualifies as an approved PV GreenCard Installer, accredited by SAPVIA, the South African Photovoltaic Industry Association. The accreditation sets the national standard for solar installation quality and safety, and applies to Nito's solar work from this point forward.

The Silvermine Milestone

In the same year, Nito Industries delivers the Silvermine Village solar project, a R17 million installation serving 217 homes, a commercial kitchen and an 80-bed healthcare facility. It is the project that cements Nito's reputation as a commercial-scale solar contractor.

2023
2025

Building What's Next

110+ residential solar systems commissioned. Vodacom DAS builds at the Reserve Bank, Westin Hotel and Parrow Mall complete. The commercial solar pipeline continues to grow.

Watch This Space

New projects, new capabilities, same standards.

2026
The People Behind It

Meet the
Van der Merwes.

M
Founder & Director
Marius van der Merwe

Marius is the technical backbone of Nito Industries. With three decades in the field, from the first Vodacom towers in 1995 through to solar and civil works today, there are few sites in the Western Cape that Marius hasn't worked on in some capacity. He is known for his exacting standards, his ability to solve problems that stump others and his refusal to ever take a shortcut that could come back to bite a client years down the line.

His philosophy is straightforward: do the job properly the first time, stand behind your work and build relationships that last longer than the projects.

"I've always believed that the quality of your work is your name. Every cable I've run, every panel I've mounted, that's my signature. I want Nito to be known as the company that never compromised."
T
Director & Operations Lead
Thomas van der Merwe

Thomas grew up on job sites. While other kids were playing video games he was watching his father commission telecom towers and helping carry cable at weekends. That upbringing gave him something rare: an engineer's instinct combined with a business mind. Thomas handles project management, client relationships and business development, making sure that Nito's technical excellence translates into projects delivered on time, on budget and to specification.

He is an approved PV GreenCard Installer, accredited by SAPVIA. He identified the solar opportunity early and led Nito's move into the sector.

"Working with my dad isn't always easy. He has very high standards and expects the same from everyone around him. But it's made me a better engineer, a better businessman and if I'm honest, a better person."
